name: delivery-app
description: Independent courier application for physical bank card delivery

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run test:watch -w backend" "npm run test:watch -w frontend"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w backend && npm run test:coverage -w frontend
